records: On 14 September 1959 at 5:10-15 in the morning three witnesses south of Sali (Algeria) were intrigued by the evolution of an orange-coloured luminous body in the sky. At 5:30 the object is stationary. For 40 minutes they find that the body slowly drifts towards the NE by frequently changing its appearance and colour…
